applicability.notes: Source-permitted, conditional, not live-observed. Codex does not write costUsd. Runtime priceUsageUpdates can catalog-price a complete same-model delta. A zero first counter is not an unpriced sample. A positive baseline or a gap leaves coverage partial once a later delta is priced. Normal backend emits field.cost only for complete or partial. state.cost_unavailable is not produced by that mapping. state.cost_missing remains possible before any priced total. Priced flames 0-4 are possible on an observed working body; the tier is not chosen here. It does not mean the row value is missing. classification.adapterEmittable and uiReachable stay unknown. A raw adapter property is not the row field, and a catalog consumer is not a proven UI path.  This record does not emit state.cost_complete, state.cost_partial, state.cost_unavailable, state.cost_missing, state.burn_flames_0, state.burn_flames_1, state.burn_flames_2, state.burn_flames_3, state.burn_flames_4, or state.burn_unpriced. Those predicates stay downstream. PENDING DOWNSTREAM MAPPING. The declaration says USD uses counter deltas and model metadata, but the producer never writes a USD field. Token pricing is emitted and is recorded on field.tokens. Do not treat a gap as a zero cost. Absence of cost here does not forbid field.cost from a catalog step this adapter does not perform. The adapter does not write this MonitorAgentRow property. That is the architecture, not a conclusion that the row predicate is unreachable.
